slide_title: Self Attention Mechanism (Linear Transformation of Inputs)
subtitle_or_header: (Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )

layout.arrangement: Two-line bold title centered at top on white; yellow slide-number badge '13' at top-right. Below, one large peach panel with thin red border fills the rest of the slide and contains a single left-to-right self-attention flowchart: translucent blue-gray ellipse of input embeddings X₁–X₄ (far left) → bright-green ellipse holding four W_k^(r) boxes → four green K₁–K₄ vectors → gray 'Dot Product' box containing a graph of four blue dots → vertical lavender 'Soft max' block (center) → four red ⊗ multiply nodes stacked under a light-blue Σ box labeled 'Weighted SUM' → green block arrow up to a small dashed output box labeled 'V' (top center-right). A right-hand column of four green W_v^(r) boxes with V₄–V₁ vectors feeds the ⊗ nodes from a green dashed container of X₁–X₄ embeddings at far right. Bottom-left: green dashed container with the sentence embeddings, row X₂ highlighted with red dashed border and a red cursor arrow. Bottom-right: white annotation box with the 1*d → W(d*d) = 1*d dimension note.

layout.hierarchy: The flowchart dominates ~85% of the slide area. Title text is the largest type (bold). Most visually salient: red arrows/labels and bright-green shapes; then the large lavender Softmax block, gray Dot Product box and blue Σ; smallest are the pill labels and vector cell stacks. Blue is reserved for Σ, pill labels and the title parenthetical; red marks the attended word X₂ and all data-flow arrows.

visual_elements.description: Full-slide content panel: light peach rectangle with thin red border enclosing everything below the title

Input embedding stack: large translucent blue-gray ellipse containing 4 horizontal rows of 3–4 small colored squares (yellow, salmon, purple); each row ends with a red label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; short red arrows exit each row rightward into the W_k boxes

Key-matrix stage: bright green vertical ellipse overlapping the input ellipse, holding four stacked green rectangles each labeled 'W_k^(r)' in white (superscript small, reads '(r)', possibly '(1)'); a black mouse cursor overlaps the third box
Key vectors: four horizontal stacks of 3 small green squares, each labeled K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄ in green text; red arrows carry them into the Dot Product box
visual_elements.position: between green ellipse and Dot Product box

visual_elements.description: Dot Product box: gray rectangle titled 'Dot Product' (black, top-left) with red 'K.q' at its top-right corner; inside, four blue circular nodes vertically staggered, interconnected by thin red directed arrows (pairwise-similarity graph); red arrows enter from the K stacks (left) and exit rightward toward Softmax
Query stage: red label 'q₂' beside a tiny 2-cell vector (yellow, purple) with arrow up into the Dot Product box; below it a white rectangle with red border containing 'W_q^(r)' in red

Sentence container (bottom-left): rounded rectangle with green dashed border holding 4 embedding rows of 3 cells each with red labels X₁–X₄; the X₂ row (purple cells) is wrapped in a red dashed outline; a red mouse-cursor arrow points up at X₂ from below; a faint dashed green curve links this container up to the input ellipse

Softmax block: tall vertical lavender rounded rectangle with the words 'Soft max' rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) in dark navy; receives red arrows from the Dot Product dots on its left edge and sends red arrows fanning out to the four ⊗ nodes on its right

Weighted-sum stage: white pill 'Weighted SUM' (blue text) above a light-blue rectangle containing a large blue 'Σ'; four red arrows rise from the ⊗ nodes into the bottom of the Σ box; a thick green block arrow points upward from Σ into the output box
Output box: small rectangle with green dashed border containing a row of 3 cells (green/gray) and green label 'V' — the final attention output vector

Multiply nodes: four circles stacked vertically under Σ, each white-filled with red border and a red '×' inside (⊗); each receives a red arrow from Softmax (left) and a red arrow carrying V_i from the right, and sends a red arrow up into Σ

Value stage: four green rectangles stacked vertically, each labeled 'W_v^(r)' in white; to their left, small 2-cell vectors (yellow/purple) with red labels V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ from top to bottom; red arrows run left from the vectors into the ⊗ nodes; short arrows connect the far-right embedding container to the W_v boxes

Right embedding container: rounded rectangle with green dashed border holding 4 embedding rows (3 multicolored cells each: yellow/salmon/purple) with red labels X₁–X₄; a faint dashed green curve links it down to the bottom-right dimension note

Dimension annotation box: white rectangle showing a small cell stack labeled '1*d' (red) → arrow → white square with black 'W' and red 'd*d' beneath it → '=' → cell stack labeled '1*d' (red); blue caption underneath: 'd: Embedding Length'

Arrow network: thin red arrows define all data flow (embeddings→W_k→K→Dot Product dots→Softmax→⊗→Σ; W_v→V_i→⊗; W_q→q₂→Dot Product); one thick green block arrow Σ→V output; faint dashed green connector curves bottom-left container→input ellipse and right container→dimension note
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with darker outline containing '13' in dark navy bold

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; the entire slide is built from vector shapes (ellipses, rectangles, dashed containers, arrows, small colored 'embedding cell' squares).

Two screen-recording mouse cursors are visible and are NOT slide content: a black arrow pointer over the third W_k^(r) box in the left green ellipse, and a red arrow pointer at bottom center-left pointing at the highlighted X₂ row.
A solid black strip runs across the very bottom edge of the frame — a video-player/letterbox artifact, not part of the slide.

colors.title_text: #000000 with blue #0070C4 parenthetical; subtitle math symbols in red #C00000

#00B050 (green ellipses, W_k/W_v boxes, dashed containers, K labels)

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Calibri/Arial-like). Title: bold, largest (~28–32 pt), two centered lines; the parenthetical '(Linear Transformation of Inputs)' is the same size in blue. Subtitle: bold, ~20 pt, black with red subscripted symbols. Diagram labels are small (~10–14 pt); math symbols use subscripts (X₁, K₁, q₂, V₁) and a superscript '(r)' on the W matrices. 'Soft max' is rotated 90° inside its block; 'Weighted SUM' uses all-caps 'SUM'. 'Similarity', 'Probabilities' and 'Weighted SUM' sit in small white rounded pills with blue text. W_k/W_v labels are white-on-green; W_q is red-on-white with red border.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — every pipeline stage, label, container and annotation is visible simultaneously; no mid-build bullet/shape reveal. The two visible mouse cursors indicate the recording captured live narration, but nothing is partially revealed.
